messages:
Eli (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: we've had recurring p95 and a couple p99 spikes on text-gen in us-west over the last 5 days. Pattern: KV cache churn + occasional oversized batches. Need clear owners, short timelines, and a temporary SLO action so frontends don't degrade.

Jordan PM: Customer pages showed errors during spikes. We need a measurable mitigation window and a comms draft if we trigger the emergency override.

Arman: I can take cache tuning and eviction policy changes. ETA Tue EOD. Will try bumping cache TTL and expose evictions metric.

Cassie: I'll own dashboards and alerts. Plan to add per-pool p95, request-size histogram, and an error-budget burn panel. ETA Mon noon.

Eli (SRE): Proposal: emergency 24h SLO slack for p95: 220ms -> 270ms, with auto-rollback if extra error-budget burn >5% in that window. Pause noncritical rollouts while override is active. Thoughts?

Jordan PM: Fine for 24h emergency. Add exact sentence for customer comms in the runbook.

Arman: Noted. After tuning, if spikes persist we should enforce max-batch-size=64 and per-pool throughput caps.

Cassie: Grafana query I'll add for p95-by-pool: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool)). Adding alert: sustained p95 delta >35ms for 15m -> page oncall with runbook link.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-8123 "us-west text-gen tail spikes - cache tuning + dashboards + SLO override" and scheduled canary deploys.

Eli (SRE): Owners & timeline: Arman -> cache tuning (Tue EOD), Cassie -> dashboards & alert (Mon noon), Jordan -> comms draft + pause rollout policy (today), Eli -> SLO override PR + gating (today 18:00). Reconvene Wed 09:30 to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO edits.

Cassie: I'll post panel and alert links in RED-8123 when live.

Arman: Adding checklist and assigning tasks in the ticket.

Jordan PM: If error-budget consumption stays high after the window we escalate to throughput caps and a temporary model-rollback.

Eli (SRE): Closing with action items captured in RED-8123. See you at Wed check-in. :calendar:
